title: ephedra regeliana
intro: Ephedra regeliana, commonly known as Ma Huang, is a type of shrub native to the mountainous regions of Asia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving circulation. The therapeutic actions of Ephedra regeliana include its ability to act as a bronchodilator, increasing oxygen flow to the lungs, and as a decongestant, reducing mucus production. The bioactive constituents of this plant include ephedrine, pseudoephedrine, and other alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
